summary: Inspected the assigned careers-vacancies reference, rendered crop and diff against the frozen 1920 px source. The section wrapper geometry passes (expected 362,486,1196x2290; actual 362,487,1196x2290), but the crop differs by 9.3498% and contains visible internal layout/control mismatches.
issues: CAR-VAC-001 | priority: high | property: first-row form grid width | expected: the Imię i nazwisko field spans the full 994 px inner form width in the reference | actual: the rendered field collapses to roughly one narrow column while the remaining row is empty | fix: restore the source-backed full-row grid span for the name field without changing the passing section bounds.

CAR-VAC-002 | priority: medium | property: attachment control icon | expected: the source upload/document icon is displayed at the right of the Załącz CV control | actual: the rendered control shows a small downward chevron | fix: render the exact sourced editable SVG attachment icon for the file control.

CAR-VAC-003 | priority: medium | property: vacancy body typography and vertical rhythm | expected: source line boxes and paragraph/list spacing align with the retained reference | actual: diff overlay shows repeated doubled text baselines and accumulated vertical displacement through body copy | fix: align line-height and paragraph/list margins to the source while preserving the passing outer geometry.
